tests: Internal expenses tool with a hard deadline (licence ends 31 March, no extension, nobody reimbursed otherwise) and systems that must be kept (SAP ledger, Okta sign-in, existing Azure subscription): all constraints, as are 7-year tax retention and who may see a claim. Finance-owned approval rules, low running cost and office-hours-only support are ranked goals. Later travel booking is future scope, not a goal or constraint. Which SAP interface exists is a material unknown. An established firm replacing a nine-year-old tool: growing or scaled, not idea.
